macros.name: Authors
macros.doc: aebxmp defines the \Authors command for setting multiple authors, the authors are accessible separately using Doc.info.Authors.

macros.name: authortitle
macros.doc: \authortitle{⟨text⟩}: The ⟨text⟩ appears in the Author Title line on the Additional Metadata dialog box.

macros.name: copyrightStatus
macros.doc: \copyrightStatus{True|False}: If True, Copyright Status is set to Copyrighted; if False, Copyright Status is set to Public Domain. If left empty, the status is set to Unknown.

macros.name: customProperties
macros.doc: You can define custom properties using the \customProperties command.

macros.name: descriptionwriter
macros.doc: \descriptionwriter{⟨text⟩}: The ⟨text⟩ appears in the Description Writer line on the Additional Metadata dialog box.

macros.name: Keywords
macros.doc: The command takes each comma-delimited list of keywords and inserts each into the dc:subject part of the metadata.

macros.name: metaLang
macros.doc: The \metaLang command allows you to document the languages used in the metadata. Multiple languages may be specified.
